title: Bare 'ticfac' never lists a live local run: it reads <cwd>/.ticfac/runs, which a run never writes
body: overview.go localRunIDs enumerates working-tree run directories, but runstate commits run state by plumbing to epic/<id> and never touches a working tree, so a checkout on main lists only merged epics (the operator's main checkout omits the live epic-2jn). The runregistry built for this (aj9) is never read by the overview, and liveness is probed with repo=cwd so a run live in another checkout reads dead. Fix: enumerate from runregistry.List and probe each run in its registered repo; test with state only on epic/<id>.
